title: OperationEvent test vectors
description: Format of test-vectors/operation-events/events.json. producer: whether a producer may emit the event (strict schema + registered reason_code/operation/state). consumer: whether a consumer must accept it (unknown members dropped, then schema; unregistered but well-formed codes/operations/states accepted). See schemas/operation-event.schema.json. An event valid for producers is always valid for consumers.
